description: One change the person made to their location history, such as renaming a place, moving a visit to another place or deleting a journey.

main.description: One change the person made to their location history, such as renaming a place, moving a visit to another place or deleting a journey. Corrections are stored separately from the samples, so working the history out again never loses them. A correction is never edited: a later one replaces it by listing it in supersedes, and two corrections to the same field that don't supersede each other are shown to the person as a conflict to settle.

evidenceId.description: What the correction applies to. A visit or journey that LogDate worked out is named by the id of one of its location samples (an app.logdate.place.sample point id); a visit the person added, by its app.logdate.place.visit record key; a place, by place: followed by its app.logdate.place.place record key; and a journey LogDate inferred between two visits, by derived:journey: followed by the owner, the device and the ids of the samples it runs between, separated by colons.

field.description: What the correction changes. label: the name shown (set label). place: which place a visit, or a place merged into another, belongs to (set place). activity: how the person traveled (set activity). start and end: when it began or ended (set startsAt or endsAt). delete: removes it from the history, and needs no value.

label.description: The new name, when field is label.

place.description: The place it belongs to now, when field is place.

activity.description: How the person traveled, when field is activity. The person choosing it confirms the journey's mode.

startsAt.description: The new start time, when field is start.

endsAt.description: The new end time, when field is end.

supersedes.description: Earlier corrections to the same field of the same thing that this one replaces.

createdAt.description: When the person made the correction, when known.
